critical_steps: A Parseval K-frame has frame operator S=KK*.
For an S-eigenvector e_k, the eigenvalue equals ||K* e_k||^2 and may vanish.
Total frame energy equals tr(S), which is the sum rather than each individual eigenvalue.
The source's per-eigenvector equality for all k is equivalent to all eigenvalues of KK* being equal.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact rank-one Parseval K-frame counterexample plus the finite-dimensional trace identity and spectral theorem.
integrity.unproved_limits: No blanket claim is made about downstream theorems that cite Proposition 2.2 without checking their additional hypotheses.

scientific_limitations: The finding corrects Proposition 2.2 and its immediate spectral consequence, not every later result in the paper.
The scalar-KK-star criterion concerns simultaneous validity of the source's eigenvectorwise identity for all eigenvectors.
An unindexed erratum or informal correction may contain the same observation.
title: Parseval \(K\)-frame energy is a trace, not an eigenvectorwise constant
